name: Video Embed TikTok
description: Embed TikTok videos into your website using Video Embed Field.
project_description: Video Embed TikTok is a provider plugin for the Video Embed Field module that adds support for embedding TikTok videos. Once installed it registers a "TikTok" provider that Video Embed Field discovers automatically. Editors paste a standard TikTok video URL (of the form https://www.tiktok.com/@user/video/{id}) into any video embed field and the module renders the official TikTok iframe embed and fetches the video's thumbnail through TikTok's public oEmbed endpoint. It ships a single plugin class and no configuration UI of its own; the provider is enabled and constrained through Video Embed Field's per-field "Allowed providers" setting. Maintained by Rahul Rasgon and sponsored by QED42.
